title: Quantum Corporate Web Platform
overview: A full corporate website for Quantum Digital Labs covering services, careers, internships, and lead capture — built as a modular React platform with clear conversion paths.
problem: The business needed one digital home that explained IT, staffing, training, and marketing offerings without confusing visitors or breaking the path to quote and contact forms.
solution: We designed a service taxonomy, role-ready careers and internship flows, and reusable page sections so marketing and delivery teams can keep content consistent as the company grows.
features: Service categories with detail and quote CTAs
Responsive layouts across desktop and mobile
deliverables: Content model for services and roles
results: Consistent conversion paths to quote and contact
Reusable section system for future pages
Faster updates without redesigning every screen
screenshots: Homepage hero with brand and primary CTAs
Services grid and category detail pages
Contact and quote success confirmation states

title: Careers & Recruitment Portal
overview: A candidate-facing recruitment experience with searchable open roles, detailed job pages, and validated applications including resume upload.
problem: Hiring managers needed structured role discovery and clean application intake instead of scattered emails and incomplete candidate details.
solution: Built filtered job listings, role detail pages with responsibilities and benefits, and an application form that captures personal, education, and experience data with file validation.
features: Search and filter by location, department, experience
Role detail pages with skills and requirements
Return path back to open roles after submit

title: Internship & Training Hub
overview: An internship and training discovery hub where learners browse role-based programs, review tech stacks, and apply with academic details.
problem: Students struggled to understand which internship role fit them, what technologies they would learn, and how to apply in one clear place.
solution: Created role-based internship cards, detailed program pages with outcomes and responsibilities, and an aligned application form for college and course information.
features: Internship roles by domain and technology
Tech stack and learning outcome sections
Apply form with academic fields and resume
Sticky apply panel on role detail pages
screenshots: Role detail with tech stack highlight

title: Growth Marketing Dashboard
overview: A campaign and analytics workspace concept for SEO, ads, and content performance — helping teams track channel health and plan next actions.
problem: Marketing teams were juggling spreadsheets and platform logins without a single view of campaign progress, channel mix, and conversion signals.
solution: Designed a dashboard-led experience with channel summaries, campaign status cards, and reporting views aligned to Quantum Digital Labs marketing services.
features: Channel overview for SEO, ads, and social
results: Single place to review channel performance
Clearer handoff between marketing and sales
Stronger demo story for marketing services

title: Cloud Ops Console
overview: An operations console concept for deployments, environment health, and release checklists — supporting Quantum cloud and maintenance service narratives.
problem: Delivery teams needed a clearer way to communicate deployment status, environment readiness, and support follow-ups to stakeholders.
solution: Built a console-style UI with environment cards, pipeline stages, and monitoring summaries that map to cloud migration, CI/CD, and maintenance offerings.
results: Better stakeholder communication on ops status
Reusable patterns for cloud service demos
